1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

1377|900ed517.name: Pilot Stonegear
1377|900ed517.text: Driving a Steam Tank isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

249713|0c768ee1.name: Odd Child
249713|0c768ee1.text: Shhh! You'll give away my hiding spot!

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings $c, I can teach you skills and techniques.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

263569|85179f46.name: Bryanna Embreeze
263569|85179f46.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Bryanna Embreeze. I am the main supplier for the Theramore Expeditionary Force.  As you improve your standing with the Theramore Expeditionary Force, I can offer you an additional selection of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

270459|35e7520b.name: Alfina Nightgaze
270459|35e7520b.text:
I was invited to visit Dalaran on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. I find this place equal parts wondrous... and unsettling.

As for you, young $C--If you have not yet done so, seek out Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind. He will teach you to reach the Cenarion Circle enclave at Moonglade.

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3963|c8a70fb5.name: Danlaar Nightstride
3963|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

5504|8fca8484.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-progress.text: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13-progress.title: The People's Militia

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

142-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-complete.text:
This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge.  Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.

We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone.  We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon.  He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life.  I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout.  Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
142-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

155-accept.name: The Defias Traitor
155-accept.text:
So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. 

You know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.

Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
155-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

155-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
155-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
155-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-complete.text:
$N, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

I salute you, Sir!
166-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

214-accept.name: Scout Riell
214-accept.text:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $N.
214-accept.title: Red Silk Bandanas

272-progress.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-progress.text: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N?  If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information.  Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
272-progress.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

5061-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-progress.text:
Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
5061-progress.title: Aquatic Form

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

7802-progress.name: Mistina Steelshield
7802-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Ironforge for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7802-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7807-progress.name: Bubulo Acerbus
7807-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7807-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78142-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78142-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78142-complete.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

78143-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78143-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78143-complete.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

78143-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78143-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143-progress.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

78145-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78145-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78145-complete.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

78145-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78145-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78145-progress.title: Arcanic Systems Manual

78146-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78146-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78146-complete.title: Goaz Scrolls

78146-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78146-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78146-progress.title: Goaz Scrolls

78148-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78148-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78148-complete.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

78148-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78148-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78148-progress.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

78149-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78149-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78149-complete.title: Fury of the Land

78149-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78149-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78149-progress.title: Fury of the Land

78150-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78150-complete.text:
Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving.

Please, take this.
78150-complete.title: Friend of the Library

79091-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79091-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. You say this is from the Ironforge library? ...I'm sure they won't miss it.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79091-complete.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

79091-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79091-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79091-progress.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

79092-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79092-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79092-complete.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79097-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79097-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79097-complete.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

79097-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79097-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097-progress.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92745-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
92745-complete.title: The State of the Mines

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92749-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-accept.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749-accept.title: A Dynamite Plan

92749-complete.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-complete.text: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...
92749-complete.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92750-accept.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92750-complete.name: Jasper Fel
92750-complete.text: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
92750-complete.title: Detonation at a Distance

92751-accept.name: Jasper Fel
92751-accept.text:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.
If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator - it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
Oh - and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your $r friend.
92751-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92751-complete.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-complete.text: Great - that's the detonator we need!
92751-complete.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92752-accept.text: That's it - the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92753-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92753-accept.text:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753-accept.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92753-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92753-complete.text: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... only one thing remains to be done.
92753-complete.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92819-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92819-accept.text: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819-accept.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92819-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92819-complete.text: I don't know what to say, $N. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
92819-complete.title: Destruction in Deadmines

952-progress.name: Onu
952-progress.text: Ah.$c. How may Onu assist you?
952-progress.title: Grove of the Ancients

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will to be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I would appreciate bringing it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96393-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
96393-complete.text:
A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.

The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.

Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge,$c. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
96393-complete.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-complete.name: Thom Filch
96403-complete.text:
Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403-complete.title: Important Heirlooms

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

97005-accept.name: Bainham
97005-accept.text:
There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
97005-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97263-accept.name: Unknown
97263-accept.text: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263-accept.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97263-complete.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
97263-complete.text:
What! I've been going to the mailbox by the bank every day looking for this package! This city needs to figure out its layout. Not easy to navigate like Aerie Peak!

Let's see what I've got... totem carving tools... spare axe... some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back.

Er, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.
97263-complete.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

98021-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
98021-complete.text:
I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.

Welcome to Westfall, $c. Let's see if we can't put you to work.
98021-complete.title: Journey to Sentinel Hill

98247-accept.name: Unknown
98247-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247-accept.title: Shipping Label

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98386-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-accept.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386-accept.title: Alther's Mill

98386-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help,$N!
98386-complete.title: Alther's Mill

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
What the Blackrock orcs don't understand is that this is a war of attrition. Their brazen push into Alliance territory has left them vulnerable and without supplies, relying on the surrounding mountains to gather resources.

An army can't run on empty bellies, $N. Go to their encampments south of Stonewatch Keep to the east and rob them of their food and weapons. Let's see the orcs' fighting spirit when they're starved and defenseless.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98387-complete.name: Marshal Marris
98387-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
98387-complete.title: Blackrock Blockade

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-complete.text:
Quite the armful you have.

While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.
98407-complete.title: Show of Force

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-complete.text:
Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $c.
98423-complete.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
